title: Google Earth satellite views of Wurtsmith AFB, Michigan on Lake Huron
description: Attachment 4 (page 40) of the BAASS April 2009 report: two stacked Google Earth satellite images showing Wurtsmith Air Force Base in Michigan beside Lake Huron, each with a placemark labeling the base. Navigation controls and Google watermarks are visible, tied to the 1975 base overflight incidents.
